sources.entry: timesfm - A pretrained foundation model from Google Research for time-series forecasting, with non-commercial default weights.

summary.one_liner: TimesFM is a pretrained decoder-only time-series foundation model from Google Research for zero-shot forecasting, with the 3.0 weights under a non-commercial license.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides the TimesFM time-series forecasting model code and links to its checkpoints on Hugging Face. TimesFM 3.0 supports univariate and multivariate forecasting, with past-only and past-and-future covariates. Its predict_batch interface takes lists of NumPy arrays of varying context lengths and returns point forecasts plus 9 quantiles (0.1 to 0.9). An MLX backend runs the model on Apple silicon without PyTorch. Earlier versions (1.0, 2.0, and 2.5) are archived or kept under v1 and src/timesfm, and the README mentions fine-tuning with LoRA via HuggingFace Transformers and PEFT.
use_cases: fine-tuning a forecasting model with LoRA
how_to_run: pip install timesfm[mlx]  # Apple silicon, no PyTorch required
git clone the repository, cd timesfm
Load checkpoint google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch via ModelConfig and call predict_batch (see README examples)
notable: TimesFM 3.0 adds native multivariate forecasting with past-only and past-and-future covariates
MLX backend for Apple silicon, numerically matched to the PyTorch backend
Outputs point forecasts plus 9 quantiles per horizon step
Available as a managed service in Google Cloud BigQuery ML, Google Sheets, and Vertex Model Garden
Includes an agent skill file (SKILL.md) and LoRA fine-tuning example
caveats: TimesFM 3.0 pretrained weights use a non-commercial license and may not be used for commercial or production purposes when self-hosted
Commercial use of 3.0 is only permitted through authorized Google Cloud services
The open version is not an officially supported Google product
summary.license: Apache-2.0 for source code and weights up to 2.5; timesfm-non-commercial-license-v1.0 for TimesFM 3.0 weights
